slides.title: "Just grabbing water."
slides.body: Forty seconds behind the fridge door. The water was never the point.

slides.title: "Just shaking it out."
slides.body: The bar has been down for a full minute. The shaking has not started.

slides.title: "Was that 12 or 13?"
slides.body: It was 11. We both know it was 11.

slides.title: "Just fixing my grip."
slides.body: Third grip fix this round. The grip was fine the first two times.

slides.title: "I'll go heavier next round."
slides.body: There is no next round. You know there is no next round.

slides.title: "My watch says I did more."
slides.body: Your watch also thinks you sleep eight hours. Your watch is very supportive.
